apps.name: Update Distro
apps.description: One-click system update for your Linux environment. Refreshes repositories and upgrades all installed packages across Alpine (apk), Debian/Ubuntu/Kali (apt), Arch (pacman), Fedora (dnf), Void (xbps), and openSUSE (zypper). Recommended to keep your environment secure and up-to-date.

install_scripts.apk:
set -e
echo '==> Updating Alpine packages (apk)...'
apk update && apk upgrade
echo '==> Alpine system updated successfully!'
install_scripts.apt:
set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
echo '==> Updating APT repositories and packages...'
apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && apt-get clean
echo '==> Distro packages updated successfully!'
install_scripts.debian:
set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
echo '==> Updating Debian packages (apt)...'
apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && apt-get clean
echo '==> Debian system updated successfully!'
install_scripts.ubuntu:
set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
echo '==> Updating Ubuntu packages (apt)...'
apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && apt-get clean
echo '==> Ubuntu system updated successfully!'
install_scripts.kali:
set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
echo '==> Updating Kali packages (apt)...'
apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && apt-get clean
echo '==> Kali system updated successfully!'
install_scripts.pacman:
set -e
echo '==> Updating Arch packages (pacman)...'
pacman -Syu --noconfirm
echo '==> Arch Linux system updated successfully!'
install_scripts.archlinux:
set -e
echo '==> Updating Arch packages (pacman)...'
pacman -Syu --noconfirm
echo '==> Arch Linux system updated successfully!'
install_scripts.dnf:
set -e
echo '==> Updating Fedora packages (dnf)...'
dnf upgrade -y
echo '==> Fedora system updated successfully!'
install_scripts.fedora:
set -e
echo '==> Updating Fedora packages (dnf)...'
dnf upgrade -y
echo '==> Fedora system updated successfully!'
install_scripts.xbps:
set -e
echo '==> Updating Void Linux packages (xbps)...'
xbps-install -Syu -y
echo '==> Void Linux system updated successfully!'
install_scripts.zypper:
set -e
echo '==> Updating openSUSE packages (zypper)...'
zypper --non-interactive refresh && zypper --non-interactive update -y
echo '==> openSUSE system updated successfully!'
install_scripts.default:
set -e
echo '==> Detecting package manager...'
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
  apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && apt-get clean
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apk update && apk upgrade
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pacman -Syu --noconfirm
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf upgrade -y
elif command -v xbps-install >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  xbps-install -Syu -y
elif command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  zypper --non-interactive refresh && zypper --non-interactive update -y
else
  echo 'No recognized package manager found.'
  exit 1
fi
echo '==> System packages updated successfully!'

apps.name: Chromium
apps.description: Open-source Chromium browser. After install, open it from the desktop menu.

apps.name: Firefox
apps.description: Firefox (ESR on Debian/Ubuntu/Kali). Find it in the desktop menu after install.

apps.name: Thunderbird
apps.description: Mozilla Thunderbird mail and calendar. Works in the desktop session after install.

apps.name: VS Code
apps.description: Visual Studio Code. Distro package is code-oss or code when available; Debian-family images download Microsoft’s .deb. Can also be installed directly from pre-packaged GitHub releases.

apps.name: Geany
apps.description: Small GTK IDE and editor. Reliable in PRoot and lighter than VS Code on phones.

apps.name: Neovim
apps.description: Neovim (nvim). Use it from Terminal or a desktop terminal emulator.

apps.name: Python
apps.description: Python 3 interpreter. pip is included when the distro ships python3-pip / py3-pip.

apps.name: Git
apps.description: Git command-line tools for cloning and committing inside the environment.

apps.name: GIMP
apps.description: GNU Image Manipulation Program. Open it from the desktop menu. Large download.

apps.name: Inkscape
apps.description: SVG editor. Works in the desktop session. Large download.

apps.name: VLC
apps.description: VLC media player. Hardware video decode is limited in PRoot; software decode still plays most files.

apps.name: MPV
apps.description: mpv, a lightweight player. Good default when VLC feels heavy.

apps.name: LibreOffice
apps.description: Writer, Calc, Impress. This is a large install and can take several minutes on a phone.
